instruction: Change the default shell for the user account from bash to zsh on Ubuntu.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing system-level shell configuration which cannot be properly verified through the OSWorld evaluation framework. Similar to the original Python symlink task, shell modifications affect system state in ways that are not reliably evaluable.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - changing default shell requires system-level modifications to /etc/passwd or using chsh command
Verification would require reading system files with elevated privileges or spawning new login sessions, which is beyond OSWorld framework capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate designation for tasks that cannot be reliably verified
Metadata explanation correctly identifies the verification challenge - system state changes that are not reliably evaluable through standard getters
Complete and accurate assessment - no evaluator logic needed for infeasible tasks
